title.narrative: Activating Village Courts in Bangladesh - Final Phase

description.narrative:
The Overall Objective of the project is: Increased access to justice for people in rural areas of Bangladesh, especially women, ethnic minorities, and disadvantaged groups.

The project has two specific objectives:

Specific Objective: Capacities of local justice actors to meet the justice needs of the population and offer appropriate legal services in the form of well-functioning village courts are improved.

Specific Objective: People living in rural areas, especially women, the poor and other disadvantaged groups are empowered to access Village Courts to resolve minor disputes.

The EU already supported the activation of Village Courts in around 1000 Unions Parishad starting from 2009 (phase I and II of the programme). With the present Contribution Agreement, the EU intends to support the activation of Village Courts in all Unions Parishad and to ensure their sustainability in view of the full transfer of responsibility for their functioning to the Government of Bangladesh.
